_comment: Network + policy config. Values marked REQUIRED_FILL_ME are intentionally NOT guessed — see README 'Before first run'. src/store/db.js loadConfig() throws if a network you actually use still has a placeholder.

ethereum.name: ethereum
ethereum._comment: PRIMARY, and the default because it is the only chain that is fully configured out of the box. The public RPCs below work without an API key but are rate-limited and shared — for real sniping put a private endpoint (Alchemy/Infura/QuickNode) FIRST in this list via SNIPER_RPC_ETHEREUM. Being 200ms behind on mainnet is the difference between minting and not.

privateRelay._comment: Optional MEV-protected submission. Flashbots Protect hides the tx from the public mempool so a frontrunner cannot copy your mint. Costs you nothing but adds a little latency, and it only helps on Ethereum mainnet where a competitive mempool actually exists. Disabled by default because a relay outage would silently kill your snipe; turn it on deliberately.

policy._comment: 12s blocks: rebroadcast rarely, but bump hard — mainnet mint gas spikes are brutal and a stale maxFee just sits there unmined.

robinhood.name: robinhood
robinhood._comment: Arbitrum Orbit L2. chainId and rpcUrls are DELIBERATELY not pre-filled: this chain's parameters are not something I can state from memory with the confidence that signing transactions demands. A wrong chainId produces a validly-signed transaction for a DIFFERENT chain — replayable by anyone, funds gone. Get the values from the official Robinhood Chain docs / chainlist.org, then set them here or via SNIPER_CHAINID_ROBINHOOD + SNIPER_RPC_ROBINHOOD. The runtime ALSO verifies eth_chainId against this value at pre-warm and refuses to fire on a mismatch.

explorerApi._comment: Optional. Etherscan-compatible verified-ABI lookup. Leave baseUrl empty to skip straight to the generic mint()/claim() selector fallback, which is the expected path on this chain today (spec 2).

marketplaceSlugs._comment: Fill in once you know what slug each marketplace uses for this chain in its API/URLs. Until then, resolving a link for this chain fails loudly (RESOLVER_UNKNOWN_CHAIN) instead of silently guessing — use /manualtarget robinhood <contract> in the meantime, which needs no marketplace at all.

policy._comment: Robinhood Chain RPC is newer/less battle-tested, so allow more attempts and a longer window than a mainnet target would need (spec 2).

base.name: base
base._comment: Fully configured. 2s blocks, cheap gas — the friendliest chain to test the whole arm/fire path on for a few cents.

polygon.name: polygon
polygon._comment: Fully configured. NOTE: Polygon's own spam filter enforces a 25 gwei priority-fee FLOOR — anything under that is dropped by most validators, hence the high default below.

solana.name: solana
solana._comment: Deposit / balance / WITHDRAWAL all work. MINTING IS DELIBERATELY DISABLED (see CAPABILITIES in src/chains/solana/executor.js): Candy Machine v3 mints go through guard accounts whose exact ordering must be assembled correctly, and a wrong assembly triggers the guard's botTax — which CHARGES you and returns SUCCESS, so retries would drain the wallet while reporting no error. Use /help to see this stated to users.

resolvers._comment: `enabled` is the on/off switch a user actually feels. false => the bot recognises the link and replies 'coming soon' with working alternatives, instead of accepting it and failing on a 401 mid-wizard (or worse, minutes before a drop). Flip to true once the matching API key is in the environment — no code change needed.

opensea._comment: LIVE on every chain listed under networks above. An API key is REQUIRED by OpenSea for the /collections endpoint — get one free at docs.opensea.io and set OPENSEA_API_KEY. NOTE: /assets/<chain>/<address> links resolve with NO key at all (the address is in the URL), so the bot stays useful if the key is missing or rate-limited. Only the CONTRACT ADDRESS and chain come from this API; price and start time are always read on-chain (see src/chains/evm/mintStage.js).

magiceden._comment: COMING SOON — code is complete and tested, but disabled until MAGICEDEN_API_KEY is obtained. Set enabled=true after adding the key.

rarible._comment: COMING SOON — code is complete and tested, but disabled until RARIBLE_API_KEY is obtained. Set enabled=true after adding the key.

limits._comment: spec 7: rate-limit /newtarget and withdrawals per user.
limits._maxMintCostComment: Hard ceiling on qty x price for ONE target, in wei (default 1 ETH). A last-resort guard against a mis-typed price or a bad on-chain read turning into a 100 ETH transaction. Raise it deliberately if you really trade at that size.
